name: hmctest
title: Harrison-McCabe statistic. Twenty simulated normals use R's generator.

origin.description: Harrison-McCabe statistic. Twenty simulated normals use R's generator.
origin.details: Harrison-McCabe statistic and a 20-draw p-value after set.seed(1).
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.

translation.description: Harrison-McCabe statistic. Twenty simulated normals use R's generator.
translation.details: Harrison-McCabe statistic and a 20-draw p-value after set.seed(1).
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from boot.rng import set_seed
from lmtest import hmctest
import numpy as np
x = np.array([1,3,2,6,5,8,7,4,9,10,12,11,15,13,14,18,16,19,17,20], float)
y = np.array([2,2,4,3,7,6,9,8,5,11,10,14,12,16,15,13,19,17,20,18], float)
z = np.sqrt(x)
print(set_seed(1); hmctest(y, x, nsim=20))
